offence: Breach of Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, team radio and in-car video evidence. The Stewards reviewed the incident between Car 11, Perez, and Car 55, Sainz. The radio traffic between Perez and his team meant that while the team did warn Perez of the approaching faster traffic, he was late reacting and therefore was in the wrong position for Sainz, who was forced to cut to the inside of Turn 15. The Stewards did not consider the situation to be dangerous, and so issue a warning consistent with the agreed guidelines.
rules_referenced: Article 37.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
